project_name.justification: The articles consistently refer to the project as the Mound Lake Property. For example: "Free Battery Enters into Binding Term Sheet for Snow Lake to Acquire an Up To 80% Interest in Free Battery's Mound Lake Property".

company_name.justification: The primary company associated with the project is Free Battery Metal Limited, as stated in the headline: "Free Battery Enters into Binding Term Sheet for Snow Lake to Acquire an Up To 80% Interest in Free Battery's Mound Lake Property".

ceo_buyer.justification: The buyer is Snow Lake Resources Ltd. The CEO of the buyer is not mentioned in the text. Pam Sangster is the CEO of Free Battery Metal Limited, the seller.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Snow Lake can earn a maximum of 80% interest through a two-stage option agreement. "Snow Lake can earn up to an 80% interest in Free Battery's Mound Lake Property."

primary_commodity.justification: The text states that the company is exploring for Lithium. "Free Battery Metal Limited is a publicly traded company exploring for Lithium."

verified_article_link.justification: The article at this link is titled "Free Battery Enters into Binding Term Sheet for Snow Lake to Acquire an Up To 80% Interest in Free Battery's Mound Lake Property", which is the transaction being analyzed.

currency.justification: The transaction details use the 'C$' symbol, indicating Canadian Dollars. "...work expenditures of at least C$1,000,000 and (y) paying C$500,000 to Free Battery..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of the two optional payments: C$500,000 for the first option and an additional C$1,000,000 for the second option. The text specifies "...paying C$500,000 to Free Battery; and... paying an additional C$1,000,000 to Free Battery (for aggregate cash payments of C$1,500,000)."

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payment in shares.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash payments are explicitly detailed, so this combined field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any issuance of shares as consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payment in share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payment in options.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The total work commitment is the sum of the commitments for both options: C$1,000,000 for the first and an additional C$1,000,000 for the second. "...having made work expenditures of at least C$1,000,000... having made additional work expenditures of C$1,000,000 (for aggregate work expenditures of C$2,000,000 (the "Work Commitment"))."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction terms include a clause that converts a party's interest to a 1% NSR if it falls below 10%. "in the event that either party's interest in the Mound Lake Property falls below 10%, such party's interest shall be converted into a 1% net smelter return royalty on the Mound Lake Property".

coverage_area_raw.justification: The second article provides an updated total area for the project after an additional acquisition: "With this acquisition, FREE now holds a total of 343 single-cell, unpatented mining claims, collectively covering an area of approximately 6,800 hectares".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is explicitly stated as hectares. "...collectively covering an area of approximately 6,800 hectares..."

resource_size.justification: The text explicitly states that there has been minimal historical exploration, implying no defined resource exists: "Historically, there has been little or no mineral exploration on or near the Mound Lake Property."

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as Snow Lake Resources Ltd., and its ticker and exchange are provided in the text: "Snow Lake Resources Ltd., (NASDAQ: LITM)".
